title: a group sent off the canvas runs off whole; no part is stretched into a bar
note: A story scene with a group that runs off: the group is sent to a point past the canvas edge with a fast move. Its body path was stretched into a long bar from the face to the stage edge and stayed so at rest. Every part moves together, rigidly, and a target off the canvas takes the whole group off the stage.

turns.say: tell me a story on the left and animate something on the right
